TRIGGER_ID=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/1314/comments?per_page=100" --jq 'map(select((.body | contains("/prflow:implement")) and ((.body | test("(pr|dev)flow:workpad")) | not))) | last | .id' 2>/dev/null)

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/react-to-trigger.sh --repo The01Geek/prflow --event issue_comment --comment "$TRIGGER_ID" --reaction hooray 2>&1 | tail -2
